subject: economics
objective: What compound growth rate does this series imply?
instruction: Marlow's output grew by a steady 8% a year for 5 years from USD 10,000,000 (the end figure is rounded to the nearest dollar), while its population grew by 3% a year from 800,000 (also rounded to the nearest person). Real output was USD 10,000,000 at the start and USD 14,693,281 at the end of 5 years, and the population went from 800,000 to 927,419. Use compound (geometric) annual rates: g = (end / start)^(1/periods) - 1, applied separately to output, to population and to output per person. Periods are years. Required: total growth rate, average annual growth rate, population growth rate, per capita annual growth rate.
